headline: Oil rises as Iran claims mine strikes on ships; OPEC+ meets 29 Nov
detail: Brent closed about $91.7 (+1.2%) after Iran said ships hit mines near Hormuz. It is still down about 16% over the month on rising Gulf exports and an IEA supply surplus. OPEC+ ministers decide 2027 output policy on 29 Nov.
impact: Brent is about $1.7 above our $90 settle level for ADNOC Drilling and Luberef. No rule fired.

headline: US October PCE inflation 3.8% y/y, core above forecasts
detail: Headline PCE rose to 3.8% from 3.6% and core PCE came in above the consensus. Futures price a December hike at about 94-98%.
impact: Keeps the plan of no property adds (Emaar, Aldar, Barwa) before 9 Dec; a 50 bp signal would trigger a review.

headline: DIB agrees all-share acquisition of Emirates Islamic
detail: Dubai Islamic Bank will buy 100% of Emirates Islamic from Emirates NBD for new DIB shares, creating a lender with about AED 585bn ($159bn) of assets, the world's second-largest Islamic bank after Al Rajhi. Needs UAE central bank and SCA approval. DIB issues about 3.49bn new shares and Emirates NBD ends with about 32.5% of DIB; no valuation or accretion figures were disclosed. DIB closed +1.6% at AED 8.92 after an 11% jump on 23 Nov.
impact: DIB was cut to index weight on 26 Nov until EPS and book-value accretion are clear; the General Assembly circular is the next test.

headline: Houthis claim strike on Ras Tanura and threaten Red Sea ports
detail: The Houthis claimed an attack on Aramco's Ras Tanura refinery and threatened Jeddah and other Red Sea ports. TASI fell 0.6% (Al Rajhi -1.2%, SNB -0.9%); Dubai rose 0.4% on Emaar +2.7%.
impact: Supports the Saudi underweight; Saudi risk is now spreading from Riyadh to the west coast.

headline: Saudi 15% minimum top-up tax from 2027; Jarir falls 8%
detail: The new domestic minimum top-up tax applies to groups with at least EUR 750m revenue, with zakat counting toward 15%. Jarir estimates about SAR 130m extra tax (about 11% of profit) from Q1 2027; ACWA is in scope but expects contract protection.
impact: Jarir overweight cut to about +0.75 pts. Other Saudi holdings are being screened for exposure at the quarterly review.

headline: Dubai +1.3% on DIB's biggest jump since 2014; Saudi slips
detail: Dubai rose 1.3% to 6,307 as DIB jumped 11% ahead of its board meeting. Saudi eased 0.2% to 9,937 with Jarir -8% and STC -2%; Qatar +0.8%.
impact: Dubai is the strongest GCC market: +10.6% in a month.

headline: TASI breaks 10,000 after the PIF tower strike and Bahrain attacks
detail: TASI fell 2.0% to 9,960 with 29 gainers and 238 losers after a Houthi missile hit the PIF tower and the group threatened the King Abdullah Financial District; Iran hit targets in Bahrain. Qatar fell 1.6%.
impact: The Saudi underweight and cash protected the fund on the day.

headline: VLCC rates down 64% from the October record despite attacks
detail: Baltic VLCC rates for Gulf of Oman to China fell to about WS 308 on 13 Nov, 64% below the 8 Oct record, as Gulf exports recovered; Kpler says MEG to China fell below $30/bbl and January freight futures are down about 50%.
impact: Triggered the partial take-profit in ADNOC L&S; tanker earnings should fall in Q4 and Q1.

headline: Nasdaq falls about 10% in a week on AI-spending doubts
detail: Reuters reported a 10% weekly fall in the Nasdaq on doubts about AI-driven growth; Korea opened about 4% lower the next Monday. The VIX is now about 28.
impact: Explains part of the foreign selling in Saudi; low beta helped.

headline: MSCI deletes five GCC stocks from 30 Nov, adds none
detail: ADES and Makkah Construction (Saudi), Mesaieed and Nebras (Qatar) and Warba Bank (Kuwait) leave the MSCI Standard indexes at the close on 30 Nov.
impact: We hold Nebras overweight: expect passive selling at the 30 Nov close.
